name: matched-present-round2
claim: At fixed fitted material physics, history identifies the otherwise hidden stress split and predicts different recontact responses for identical current observations and future commands.
unit_of_analysis: physically replayed history pair, with paired ID/held-out-wait continuations

splits.name: test_id
splits.held_out: complete history pairs and random seeds
splits.leakage_check: pair IDs disjoint; both branches remain together

splits.name: test_wait
splits.leakage_check: same unseen histories as test_id; identical current observation and commands within each pair

baselines.name: history_state
controlled_variables: all snapshot factors except access to full history

baselines.name: pair_average_oracle
baselines.category: within-pair identical-prediction lower bound, not deployable

baselines.name: local_observer
baselines.category: fixed-physics least-squares observer over the last 0.2 s of known contact, unknown start state

metrics.name: paired_response_difference_NRMSE
metrics.rationale: sqrt(sum squared errors in predicted B-A force)/sqrt(sum squared true B-A force), recontact window; identical predictions score exactly 1

metrics.name: hidden_state_contrast_NRMSE
metrics.rationale: diagnose recovery of the physical state difference not fixed by current force

ablations: state exchange between matched pair members at test time
learned command GRU with/without unilateral contact
falsification_criteria: History-state paired response NRMSE >= 0.5: does not meet the predeclared useful recovery criterion; >=1: no improvement over predicting no difference.
History-state hidden contrast NRMSE >=0.5: do not claim accurate state recovery even if absolute force prediction improves.
Learned methods fail to beat classical integration: no learning-necessity or new constitutive-law claim on known Maxwell physics.
Any run hits maximum updates without validation plateau: convergence comparison remains incomplete; retain status and resolve before final interpretation.
convergence: After >=800 updates, stop when validation loss has not improved by >=0.2% relative for 600 updates. Evaluate every 100; reduce LR by 0.5 on plateau, min 1e-5. Best checkpoint by individual future observation MSE only. Never select by test results.
training_loss: Normalized individual future force + position MSE; no paired-effect loss and no true state supervision.
physics_interface: Learned state obeys k1*z1+k2*z2=(k_inf+k1+k2)*x-F at current contact, up to positive clipping; one learned scalar distributes stress across positive modes. Snapshot and history share this constraint.
contact_control: Both sequence controls consume future commands/time/current readings with a GRU. Contact version predicts an effective free surface and solves the known unilateral actuator contact equations; force version predicts force then solves the same actuator. No true future contact input.
scope: One linear two-mode material, known actuator, relaxed initial history. Pair construction uses simulator control response only to generate trajectories; no future-effect filtering. Test wait is interpolation. No real-data result.
statistical_plan: 1500 bootstrap resamples over optimization seeds and independent history pairs. Preserve per-seed and per-pair numerators/denominators. Three seeds do not measure material-level uncertainty.

validation_only_extension.trigger: gru_contact seed 47 reached 8000 updates without validation plateau; no test-performance evaluation has occurred.
validation_only_extension.change: Raise guardrail to 20000 for unfinished runs; keep optimizer, loss, convergence threshold, and validation-only checkpoint selection unchanged.

pretest_local_observer_addition: Added before any model test evaluation to distinguish current-readout insufficiency from necessity of a long neural history; window fixed at 0.2 s without tuning.
